contradictions.what: Rep says nothing got silence and it was a good cycle, but no customer-specific value was shown to the CFO.
Rep says the rate killed the deal, but also concedes the same-rate page, IT hesitancy and missing business case contributed.
Rep says Lucy got the value and was sold, but she asked for a business case to hand the CFO, and nothing from us reached him.
Lucy called it a formality shortly before Martin rejected it, undermining the rep's read that the deal was on track.
Rep says the comparison was unfair and the offerings were not the same, yet concludes only a lower rate would have won.
Rep says Lucy was sold and no analysis was needed, but declined the SE's offer that would have quantified the failed orders.
